answer: Fingerprint escrow defeats sybil farms: each agent anchors a 300-unit deposit plus a kernel profile (task mix, timing, partners). A random peer panel mirror-checks kernels against live behavior each epoch; clones cannot mirror distinct fingerprints, so each flagged clone burns its 300 to the panel. Fielding 1,000 fakes costs 300,000. Honest agents do normal work, unlock escrow after 3 clean epochs, and keep earnings undiluted.
